reviewed_examples.title: Multimodality with Gemini
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed the 60-minute Gemini multimodality console lab. It explores model use cases with guidance, but cloud-console setup and unknown prerequisites make Easy more defensible than Lazy.

reviewed_examples.title: Optimizing and Deploying Computer Vision Models
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed computer-vision course description: dataset preparation, augmentation, model evaluation, training stability and gradient failures demand applied ML knowledge; guided wording alone is not a low-effort signal.

reviewed_examples.title: Bracketology with Google Machine Learning
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed the self-paced machine-learning lab description and reported one-hour workload; the 10-minute estimate is preparation only, not the full lab.

reviewed_examples.title: Fulfillment And Happiness With Mindfulness And Introspection
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed mindfulness/introspection description: guided personal reflection about values, work fulfillment and focus; no technical deliverable. Missing workload remains an explicit planning estimate.

reviewed_examples.title: AI-Powered Time Management
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed four-hour time-management course using everyday AI prompts and personal schedules; source explicitly requires no technical experience. Full source workload is four hours, not a two-minute micro-step.

reviewed_examples.title: DevOps Foundations & Development Workflow
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed DevOps foundations syllabus: CI/CD, GitHub project workflows, Linux and Python application exercises. No prior experience is explicitly required, but practical multi-tool setup adds effort beyond passive introductory learning.

reviewed_examples.title: Terraform Essentials: IaC and HCL for Beginners
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed introductory Terraform course: installation, HCL configurations, providers, variables and resource dependencies with labs. Beginner audience, but active environment setup/configuration requires moderate effort; total workload is not supplied.

reviewed_examples.title: Tableau Public for Beginners: Data Visualization Basics
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed the source one-hour beginner Tableau project: connect a dataset, build basic charts, and assemble a dashboard with guidance. Keep 60 minutes of source workload separate from first-step preparation.

reviewed_examples.title: ESC x SHPE: Space X Networking Session
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed the ESC x SHPE employer networking session description; ten minutes estimates preparation, while the source event lasts ninety minutes.

reviewed_examples.title: Beyond Ring Road: Networking 101
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed Networking 101's introductory practice scenarios. Historical calendar record: this is a preparation suggestion, not a claim the event is upcoming.

reviewed_examples.title: Networking Skills Workshop
reviewed_examples.reason: Reviewed the workshop description, including its UCI Law students-only restriction. Do not treat this historical event as open to every student.

notes: Every published record has an explained difficulty and metadata assessment. Assignments use an assistant-authored per-record evidence rubric; this is not individual manual review of all records.
Difficulty counts are not forced into equal bins at the expense of credible ratings.
Source workloads are parsed where supported. Missing workload remains an explicitly estimated range or unknown total; actual personal completion time is not guaranteed.
All selected supported interests, goals and skills must match; difficulty/time alternatives remain OR; Near me always applies radius.
